integrity: Universal claim supplied with a direct symbolic reconstruction proof and two executed independent finite cross-check scripts; finite tests do not prove all k.
scientific_limitations: Uniqueness is restricted to ordinary linear palindromes and full contiguous factor multiplicities of lengths at most k. No general fiber classification at lengths exceeding 3k is claimed. The proceedings full text from 2014 was inaccessible; related scientific presentation and abstract were read, and originality remains subject to unindexed prior research.
title: A sharp \(3k+1\) threshold for reconstructing palindromes from contiguous-factor counts
